certifications.summary: PyJHora Tier B still passes 35 of 35 Drik rows, but the locked independent Jagannatha Hora 8.0 witness passes only 9 of 35 and fails 26 at the frozen 0.5-virupa tolerance. Named sensitivity profiles improve descriptive agreement but remain diagnostic; certification stays blocked pending explicit doctrine reconciliation.

The locked JHora witness includes 245 top-level and 350 visible Kaala-subcomponent rows. Dynamic Paksha passes 35 of 35 and is promoted; displayed Sun/Moon Chesta remains excluded from totals. Exact-time Hora is independently witness-aligned in 35 of 35 rows, but that narrow result does not certify aggregate Kaala or full Shadbala. The corrected reconciliation uses the actual BPHS-labeled production Sthana profile rather than substituting the separate PyJHora-compatible diagnostic profile. Production Sthana passes 1 of 35; full total passes 3 of 35 with 11.829 virupa mean absolute error at the frozen 0.5-virupa tolerance. Nathonnatha, Ayana, aggregate Kaala, non-luminary Chesta, Drik, Sthana, and full Shadbala remain uncertified.

The completed 245-row locked JHora witness is admitted component by component at the unchanged 0.5-virupa tolerance. Naisargika is aligned in 35/35 top-level rows. Abda, Hora, Masa, Vara, Tribhaga, Paksha, and Yuddha are aligned in 35/35 visible Kaala rows. The gate compares the actual production source profile: Sthana passes 1/35 and full total passes 3/35. Dig, aggregate Kaala, Chesta, Drik, Sthana, and full total remain provisional. Independent witness alignment is not source certification, financial validation, or execution permission.

The visible JHora Sthana witness is complete: 175 of 175 hashed rows across five fixtures, seven planets, and five components, with every component sum reconciled to the locked top-level total. Uchcha, Ojayugma, Kendradi, and Drekkana match 35 of 35 under the production implementation. The BPHS-labeled source Saptavargaja profile matches 3 of 35 and complete production Sthana remains 1 of 35. A separately named JHora-visible compatibility profile combines the observed relationship weights with degree-bounded D1 Moolatrikona and matches every component and complete Sthana total 35 of 35. It remains diagnostic only; source certification, financial validation, ML admission, production replacement, and execution are false.

The fail-closed JHora intermediate packet is complete. Exact-time recapture proves Hora alignment in 35 of 35 rows; the case-8 bundle binds visible LMT 23:18:36.072, apparent-tip sunrise 6:22:22, Moon as Hora lord, Moon 60 virupa, and six zero awards. Hora is independently witness-aligned only; this does not certify aggregate Kaala or full Shadbala. Nathonnatha formula profile V2 explicitly tests LMT, equation-of-time apparent solar time, and the nearest sunset/sunrise midpoint. Each passes only 11 of 35 visible rows, so the astronomical-midnight compatibility hypothesis is rejected and the source-backed LMT production formula remains unchanged. The seven-planet historical Ayana observation is provenance-complete, but five tropical-longitude reconstruction residuals exceed the frozen 0.5-virupa tolerance, so that candidate is also rejected. Source certification, financial validation, ML promotion, Auto Suggest changes, live inference, and execution remain blocked.
Specific grid and editor-supplement guidance pages are certified; absolute orientation and complete financial doctrine are not.
The image scan is incomplete and the searchable edition is derivative; neither enables an executable financial profile.

Printed pages 180-194 are intact and visually checked, so they may support opt-in local RAG hypotheses; they remain modern commentary and are excluded from doctrine, deterministic scoring, Auto Suggest, live inference, official ML notes, and execution.

The complete 118-page scan and aligned OCR companion are acquired. Printed pages 4-5 certify a source-specific guidance profile with all three directions for Sun, Moon, Rahu, and Ketu. The Arghya numeric tables have matching 108-cell passes from 1972 and the same-lineage 2016 reprint. An independent Krishna Rau witness supports the 11|15 correction candidate and 1/20 reference unit, but 2|18 and score-to-price arithmetic remain unresolved.

Two image-controlled passes agree on all 108 cells and distinguish Viswa-Kala from house-list notation. Krishna Rau independently prints 11|15 and confirms the 1/20 reference unit, but also independently prints 2|18. No complete page-cited rule maps a net score to units or a target price. Only guarded direction/reference-unit evidence is available; direct price, market labels, Auto Suggest, inference and execution remain blocked.

Krishna Rau/Choudhary independently supports 11|15 and the 1/20 = 5% reference unit. The same source preserves 2|18, and the available 1951 silver pages omit the complete score-to-price working. No correction is applied at runtime and reusable price prediction remains blocked.

Four additional private files were classified without double counting: the Khemraj file is a same-lineage Trailokya reprint, the unattributed introduction is a Phaladeepika-derived duplicate and is excluded, the P.V.R. article is modern reference commentary, and selected Krishna Rau/Choudhary financial pages are an opt-in hypothesis reference. No deterministic SBC or trading capability is upgraded.

Research mechanics are tested. A narrow Trailokya Vedha profile now exists, but its financial Arghya layer and the complete Agarwal profile remain blocked; a separate purged validation gate is still required.
